chunks: And Ibrāhīm ibn Maymūn narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام:
Regarding a man leading women in the obligatory prayer, when there is no man with them, he عليه السلام said: "Yes; and if there is a boy with him, then he should stand beside him."

key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: the women being led in prayer
key_terms.جَانِبِهِ: his side, meaning beside the Imam
key_terms.صَبِيٌّ: a boy present in the prayer congregation
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: leads as Imam in congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: Can a man lead women in obligatory congregational prayer if no other man is present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning congregational salat in which a man leads women in an obligatory prayer when no other adult man is present. It also clarifies the placement of a boy present in the congregation, stating that he stands beside the Imam.
